name: arxisvr-monorepo
description: ArxisVR - Plataforma BIM colaborativa com AR/VR

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:signaling" --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,SIGNALING" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.prestart: if [ "$NODE_ENV" != "production" ]; then npm run setup:links; fi
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:signaling" --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,SIGNALING" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../signaling-server && npm install

author: ArxisVR Team
